wikipedia.extract: Chlamydera is a genus of passerine birds in the bowerbird family Ptilonorhynchidae that are found in Australia and New Guinea. The birds in this genus build "avenue-type" bowers which consist of two parallel walls made of vertical sticks and pieces of grass.
wikipedia.title: Chlamydera

commonNames.name: Moor Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Moor macaque (Macaca maura) is a macaque species with brown/black body fur with a pale rump patch and pink bare skin on the rump. It has ischial callosities, which are oval-shaped.
wikipedia.title: Moor macaque

commonNames.name: Black-eared Catbird
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black-eared catbird (Ailuroedus melanotis) is a species of bowerbird (Ptilonorhynchidae) which can be found northern Queensland, Australia, and New Guinea, including its surrounding islands. They are named after their cat-like wails and black ear spot.
wikipedia.title: Black-eared catbird

wikipedia.extract: The cockatiel (Nymphicus hollandicus), also known as the weero/weiro or quarrion, is a species of small- to medium-sized parrot belonging to the cockatoo family (Cacatuidae), of which it is the smallest member. Native to Australia, it is the sole member of the genus Nymphicus.
wikipedia.title: Cockatiel

wikipedia.extract: Coragyps is a genus of New World vulture that contains the black vulture (Coragyps atratus) and two extinct relatives.
wikipedia.title: Coragyps

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus mittermeieri Louis Jr., Coles, Andriantompohavana, Sommer, Engberg, Zaonarivelo, Mayor & Brenneman, 2006

wikipedia.extract: Mittermeier's mouse lemur (Microcebus mittermeieri) is a species of mouse lemur known only from Anjanaharibe-Sud Special Reserve in Madagascar. Mittermeier's mouse lemur is one of the smallest mouse lemurs, but is larger than Madame Berthe's mouse lemur, the smallest member of not only cheirogaleid family, but of all primates.
wikipedia.title: Mittermeier's mouse lemur

commonNames.name: African Clawed Frog
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The African clawed frog (Xenopus laevis), also known as simply xenopus, African clawed toad, African claw-toed frog or the platanna) is a species of African aquatic frog of the family Pipidae. Its name is derived from the short black claws on its feet.
wikipedia.title: African clawed frog

wikipedia.extract: The Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) is a species of ray-finned fish in the family Salmonidae. It is the third largest of the Salmonidae, behind Siberian taimen and Pacific Chinook salmon, growing up to 1 m (3.3 ft) in length.
wikipedia.title: Atlantic salmon

wikipedia.extract: Patagioenas is a genus of New World pigeons whose distinctness from the genus Columba was long disputed but ultimately confirmed. It is basal to the Columba — Streptopelia radiation with their ancestors diverging from that lineage likely over 8 million years ago.
wikipedia.title: Patagioenas

wikipedia.extract: The cloven-feathered dove (Ptilinopus holosericeus) is a species of bird in the family Columbidae. The cloven-feathered dove is endemic to New Caledonia where it is found in forest and Melaleuca savanna at altitudes up to 1,000 m (3,300 ft).
wikipedia.title: Cloven-feathered dove

wikipedia.extract: The Australasian wrens are a family, Maluridae, of small, insectivorous passerine birds endemic to Australia and New Guinea. While commonly known as wrens, they are not closely related to the true wrens.
wikipedia.title: Australasian wren

wikipedia.extract: The bat hawk (Macheiramphus alcinus) is a raptor found in sub-Saharan Africa and south Asia to New Guinea. It is named for its diet, which consists mainly of bats.
wikipedia.title: Bat hawk

wikipedia.extract: The small bird genus Geronticus belongs to the ibis subfamily Threskiornithinae. Its name is derived from the Greek gérontos (γέρωντος, "old man") in reference to the bald head of these dark-plumaged birds; in English, they are called bald ibises.
wikipedia.title: Geronticus

wikipedia.extract: Nyctipolus is a genus of South American nightjars in the family Caprimulgidae.
wikipedia.title: Nyctipolus

gbif.scientificName: Sahelanthropus Brunet, Guy, Pilbeam, Mackaye et al., 2002

wikipedia.extract: Sahelanthropus is an extinct genus of hominid dated to about 7 million years ago during the Late Miocene. The type species, Sahelanthropus tchadensis, was first announced in 2002, based mainly on a partial cranium, nicknamed Toumaï, discovered in northern Chad.
wikipedia.title: Sahelanthropus
